summary.result: The strength of this study is to approach the temporal change of migration from the viewpoint on quantitative and structural characteristics.
summary.background: In this study, we visualized the regional migration in Korea from 2001 to 2015 using the Chord diagram which can represents amount of migration and flows at the same time.
